sentences.text: Return of T Mac knocked off first-place Lil Fridge 101.61 to 89.77 in an upset.
Bryce Young finished dead last among started QBs while Caleb Williams sat on the bench with 22.12, enough to flip the result.
Brutal lineup call.
Bijan Robinson, a recent add by trade, scored 14.7 and still outscored the margin on his own.
Courtland Sutton, the recent add on the losing side, managed 6.
Christian McCaffrey put up 19 for the league leaders and is now listed Questionable.
Caleb Douglas, the new pickup, turned a 6.25 projection into 20.
Unsolicited Dak Picks beat behold the lamb 106.12 to 91.65 in an upset.
Douglas outscored the margin on his own, so without him, that is a loss.
The lamb in question, CeeDee Lamb, posted 21.9 for the losing side anyway.
Saquon Barkley, also on that roster, is now listed Questionable.
Tony Pollard, the week 6 trade pickup for Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team, was Top Scorer with 35.
Unsolicited Dak Picks left Dak Prescott on the bench, and he became the bench player with the most points in the league.
Their new pickup Caleb Douglas took the Game Changer anyway, scoring 20 on a 6.25 projection.

Tony Pollard put up 35 for Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team, most among started running backs, on an 86 percent carry share.
Joe Burrow topped the quarterbacks at 28.88 for All You Need Is Love, and naturally the tight end right behind the league leader at that spot was named Loveland.

Trey McBride owned the tight ends with 22.1 for Bo Girds.
Lil Fridge started Bryce Young for 7.42 while Caleb Williams sat on the bench with 22.12, a swap that would have flipped this one.
Return of T Mac took the upset anyway, and the other side's Christian McCaffrey is now listed Questionable.
Both sides started a recent add: Bijan Robinson posted 14.7 after his trade, while the free agent pickup Courtland Sutton managed 6.
Brock ‘N’ Roll beat Maye d'force B with U 85.87 to 81.19 in an upset, and both sides needed a season low to get there.
The winners' recent adds barely showed up, with Chris Godwin Jr. at 4.7 and the new pickup Jets defense at -0.55.
Jalen Coker, Jahmyr Gibbs and the Niners defense all blew it for the losing side, and Jaylen Waddle is now listed Questionable.
Unsolicited Dak Picks won 106.12 to 91.65 in an upset, climbing past a side that sat above them before the week.
Caleb Douglas, the new pickup, outscored the margin on his own with 20, and fellow recent add Josh Jacobs chipped in 17.6.
At least CeeDee Lamb showed up for behold the lamb, and Saquon Barkley is now listed Questionable.

To top off the week, Woody Marks, Drake London and Amon-Ra St. Brown are all now listed Questionable.

Devaughn Vele, the new pickup, chipped in 13.9 for the losing side, and they still dropped a 3rd straight.
On the winning side, Aaron Jones Sr. is now listed Questionable.

Their recent adds flopped: the Titans defense, a free agent add, finished at -0.7, and Jaylin Noel, now listed Questionable, scored 0.7.
On the other side, the trade pickup Cam Skattebo outscored the margin on his own and is now listed Questionable.

Unsolicited Dak Picks cleared it by 2.26, and Return of T Mac missed it by exactly that much.

Pukancun on 3 also found a season high, a fine time to show up for the team in last place.
